item.title: Pakistan PM: Aggression against Iran main cause of regional crisis; diplomacy only solution
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA – Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has said that the violation of Iran’s sovereignty and territorial integrity earlier this year triggered a major regional crisis, stressing that diplomacy remains the only sustainable way to resolve the conflict.
